opportunities.name: United flight search
opportunities.description: Search United.com for flights from {origin} to {destination} on {dates}, with trip type, miles option, travelers and cabin set, then review or pick fares.
steps: Open the United home page Book > Flight tab
Choose Roundtrip or One-way; tick 'Book with miles' if needed
Click From, type the origin city and pick the suggested airport
Click To, type the destination and pick the suggested airport
Open the date picker, go to the right month, and click the depart date (and the return date)
Open Travelers and set the number of adults and children
Choose a cabin class if needed
Click Find flights
Review results and select a fare, or open flight details or seats

opportunities.name: Tripadvisor restaurant search with filter
opportunities.description: On Tripadvisor, open Restaurants, search a {location}, then apply a {cuisine/feature} filter to the restaurant list, and optionally save a restaurant to a trip.
steps: Click the Restaurants tab on the Tripadvisor home page
Click 'Where to?' and type the location
Pick the matching location from the suggestions
Scroll to the filters (if needed, click 'More restaurants' or 'Show more' under Cuisine)
Tick the cuisine, dietary or feature filter and click Apply
Optionally open a restaurant and save it to a new trip named after the location

instances.values: Central Park, New York; cuisine Italian
Los Angeles; cuisine Indian; saved Urban Masala to new trip 'Los Angeles'
Big Sur, CA; feature Outdoor Seating

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, search a {venue}, pick an {event} (optionally by date), set the parking entry/exit times or a filter such as wheelchair accessible, and update the results.
steps: Click the SpotHero search box and type the venue name
Pick the venue from the Google suggestions
In the venue events dialog, optionally pick an event date, then click the event
Optionally click Filter, tick a filter (e.g. Wheelchair Accessible) and click Show results
Optionally change the Enter After / Exit Before times and click Update Search
Optionally click Book Now on a parking spot

instances.values: Barclays Center; Orlando Magic at Brooklyn Nets Apr 7; times 3:00-5:00 PM; Book Now on 201 S Portland Ave

opportunities.name: United Explore destinations map search
opportunities.description: Use United's 'Explore destinations' map search from {origin airport} with trip type, dates mode and max price to find cheap destinations.
steps: Open BOOK menu > Map search (Explore destinations)
Click 'Flying from', type the origin and pick the airport
Set trip type (Roundtrip) and Dates (Exact or Flexible dates)
Set max price if needed
Click Search
Open 'List of search results' to review destinations

instances.values: Las Vegas LAS, Roundtrip, Flexible dates (next 30 days), $2000
